title: The pre-training loop end to end
description: Next-token window sampling, cross-entropy and perplexity, AdamW with warmup and cosine decay, gradient clipping, validation against a unigram baseline, sampling, and the parameter, memory, FLOP and throughput arithmetic of a run.

title: Gradient clipping and accumulation
description: Global-norm clipping preserves direction and caps length; accumulating micro-batch gradients weighted by their size reproduces the large-batch gradient.

title: Weight tying
description: Sharing the token-embedding matrix with the output head saves V*d parameters (GPT-2 small: 163M untied vs 124M tied).

title: Heuristic and model-based quality filtering
description: Length, symbol and repetition rules, perplexity filters and a bag-of-words logistic quality classifier; what they catch, what they miss and the bias of the labels.

title: Exact and near-duplicate detection
description: Normalised hashing, word shingles, Jaccard similarity, MinHash signatures, LSH banding with collision probability 1-(1-s^r)^b, verification, and measured recall and precision.

title: Benchmark decontamination
description: N-gram overlap scores between training text and evaluation items, overlap-fraction thresholds, false positives from boilerplate, false negatives from paraphrase and translation.

title: Data mixtures and curricula
description: Source sampling weights, temperature sampling n^alpha, epochs per source, and ordering data over training.

title: PII scrubbing, licensing and consent
description: Regex and NER scrubbing of personal data with their limits, and the provenance records needed for licence, opt-out and audit questions (not legal advice).
